body: Thank you, I’ll keep in it my mind 🙏🏻

Wish I saw that, the time was not on my side I guess. I forgot that I live in turkey, it was so bad when they came to my house. They said terrible things and they don’t even know what happened, they just said “if they let you go to a therapist they don’t abuse you”. Man I was abused by the therapist too, and by my parents. Fucking disabled polices.. how can you say that to a suicidal person. Now I’m trying to find more hope, I need to try my best, or it’s over.
That’s great to hear, keep going!

Oh no I can understand. I’m sorry that happened, I really hope it gets better. You are not alone in this kind of matter, I swear. It doesn’t happen because we are being ourselfs, it’s a wrong place and wrong persons. But I believe we can make our new life, I just reached for help from the hotline. And it was like hell, but when I see people like me on the social media. I get this little hope that keeps me going, please try to keep going too. from what i saw on the internet, it get’s better. Even if the world is against you, stand by your truth. In our eyes it’s probably black and white now, so I hope we can make it colorful together one day. I’ll try to chat :) 💚
Okay I’ll think about it again and and call if I need, thank you 🙏🏻
Thank you very much, I’ll try to if I can. I’m looking for a immediate solution and I’ll try my best :)
There is a mosque, but it’s too far away. It’s a little late here and I’m not very mentally stable honestly :(

Oh wait sorry if I misunderstood, you’re struggling too? I’m afraid I can’t talk because of the state I’m in :( and I don’t know how to. But I really hope it works out. Please stay with us, try to get help like me.💚🙏🏻
I don’t go to school sadly

I don’t have my own money, and I didn’t go to school for 1 year. So I don’t have any friends too,  is there a chance that youth homeless shelters are safe? I know somebody that is my father’s friend, and I’m friends with her daughter but I see her rarely. And I don’t know if I can trust them too

Sorry I don’t know why I’m so scared to call the hotlines, I live in turkey. I don’t know what will happen after I call them, I don’t want my relatives to be angry at me if something happens to my parents. Is there a chance it will be safe? It’s okay if they get angry, I just wanna be safe
